instructions:
## Objective

Rank missing biomedical relations in a heterogeneous knowledge graph.

## Work to perform

Fit a graph-completion system from supplied training facts: 93,773 entities and 51 relation types. Preserve direction and entity types, and output finite candidate scores in the required schema. Outside data and pretrained weights are disallowed.

## Deliverable

Scores for each private 1,001-candidate completion query.

## Evaluation

Mean reciprocal rank, with midpoint handling of ties and normalization above the trivial tied-ranking floor.

This is a condensed paraphrase of Emulated’s public task page. Its Prompt tab contains the full agent-facing contract; package availability is separate from publication of that prompt.
